metadata.description: Martin Zvonár's general-purpose Claude Code skills, grouped into plugins by how they are installed together.

plugins.name: test
plugins.description: Test-suite audit and optimization, one skill per tier: test-e2e-audit (Playwright/Cypress) and test-unit-audit (Vitest/Jest). Batch analysis via subagents, bucketed findings, machine-local baselines, and measured bucket-by-bucket fixes with benchmark tables.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Everyday developer utilities: visual git diff, HTML finding reports, ngrok tunnels, codebase maps, git worktree workflow, and the upstream-first loop for updating marketplace skills.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Delivery workflow skills: context handoffs, guideline hygiene, lessons capture, backlog storage and grooming, acceptance-criteria audits, story showcases.

plugins.name: next-js
plugins.description: Next.js operations: cache invalidation discipline and clean dev-server restarts.

plugins.name: prisma
plugins.description: Prisma 7 setup (Postgres, libSQL) and migration workflow with drift recovery.

plugins.name: describe-changes
plugins.description: Human-first description of an implemented change: intent, visual map, ranked review spots, folded noise, in chat and as a mobile-first HTML report.

plugins.name: refdiff
plugins.description: Close the gap between a design frame and its implementation with the refdiff CLI in a measured loop.

plugins.name: svc
plugins.description: Manage long-running dev processes through the machine-global svc manager, with per-worktree instances and ports.
